examples.text: „Das akrale In-situ-Melanom ist oft schwer von einem akralen Nävus zu unterscheiden.“

glosses: Of or pertaining to peripheral body parts, such as toes and fingers.

examples.text: Acral melanoma is a type of skin cancer that occurs on fingers, palms, soles, and nail beds.
Acral distribution of a dermatosis means it affects distal portions of limbs (hand, foot) and head (ears, nose).
